description: Revision of the monthly allowance paid to the employees of Powerloom Enterprises, which were privatized during the period of 1980-1982, owned by the Department of Textile Industries
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been identified that the monthly allowance being paid to employees who lost their jobs due to the privatization of the Powerloom Enterprises which were under the Department of Textile Industries and who were unable to claim for a pension due to not completing 10 years of service, is insufficient in view of the prevailing cost of living. Although the possibility of providing benefits under the Aswesuma Programme to those employees has been examined as per the Cabinet decision dated 2025-04-21, it has been found that it is not possible to provide such relief directly to them under the existing legal provisions. Therefore, the Cabinet having been informed by the Minister of Industry and Entrepreneurship Development, on measures taken to revise the monthly allowance of employees receiving a monthly allowance less than Rs.5000 from among them, as Rs.5000 to be effective from 2026-01-01, as a relief for them and make payments, it was decided to grant the concurrence of the Cabinet to pursue action accordingly.
